# Harbor Bikes Shipping Policy

Last updated: September 1, 2026.

## Where we ship
We ship to all 50 US states. We do not ship internationally, and we do not ship bikes to PO boxes.

## Rates
- Accessories and parts: free standard shipping on orders of $75 or more; otherwise $7.95 flat.
- Bikes: $89 flat rate to the contiguous US; $189 to Alaska and Hawaii.
- E-bikes: $149 flat rate to the contiguous US. Because of battery shipping rules, e-bikes cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.
- Local delivery within 10 miles of the New Haven shop is free for all bikes, including e-bikes.
- Prices in the price list are in US dollars and do not include sales tax or shipping.

## Timing
- Orders placed by 2 p.m. Eastern on a business day ship the same day.
- Accessories and parts arrive in 3 to 6 business days. Bikes arrive in 5 to 8 business days.
- We email a tracking number when the order ships.

## How bikes arrive
Bikes ship about 85% assembled in a padded box. Final assembly takes about 30 minutes with a 5 mm Allen key; follow the assembly instructions in the box. If you prefer, bring the bike to the shop within 30 days for a free safety check.

## Shipping your own bike
We pack customer bikes for shipping for $40 (service SKU SRV-BOX in the price list). The shipping cost is quoted separately.

## Damaged deliveries
Report shipping damage within 48 hours, with photos, to help@harborbikes.example. We repair or replace the item and pay the return shipping.
